entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *sigh* Looks like they're not doing their[n]famous double chocolate crêpes today...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like it's from the agency.[n]I wonder what they could want...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They want me to head over for[n]a shoot now... Feels pretty[n]familiar, doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Basically, this men's magazine is running[n]a Mika special to try and capitalize on[n]her recent popularity.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But apparently, she asked for me[n]specifically to star alongside[n]her for the shoot...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: H-Huh!? So you think what she[n]said earlier was the truth!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hold on though... Why would[n]you trick someone you admire?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I guess I won't know what[n]she wants unless I head over!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Have you been to Skytree[n]before? How do you get there...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, and... c-can you come with me?[n]Actually, I've already decided for you.[n]You're going. Come on!
